claims.statement: For every full-column-rank M0 and arbitrary Boolean D(u,z), the aligned shield P=(-1)^(x^T M0 u+affine)D has H(P)=2r+E_u H(D_u) and I(P)>=r+E_u I(D_u) in the original physical basis.

quantifiers.core: every Boolean D on r+t bits
quantifiers.physical_alignment: the z block spans the kernel

claims.statement: For aligned kernel width t, arbitrary finite adaptive/pruned physical restriction trees and an arbitrary common disjoint Boolean terminal core have retained-U loss at most max(2,C_t) I(P), where C_t is the exact t-bit FEI constant.

quantifiers.tree: every finite deterministic adaptive/pruned tree on P variables
quantifiers.terminal_core: every Boolean h on a disjoint block
quantifiers.activation_probability: all dyadic leaf probabilities generated by uniform physical restrictions
quantifiers.constant: independent of rank, bias, overlap, address count, tree depth and reveal order; dependent only on t

claims.scope: All genuine Boolean functions through four physical input bits, modulo global output complement.

certificate.arithmetic: integer Walsh transforms, rational influence, positive-series rational logarithm intervals

claims.statement: A dimension-independent FEI bound for all aligned widths already implies full FEI, even when the nontrivial shield rank is fixed to one, by applying the bound to (-1)^(xu) g^tensorN and taking N to infinity.
